columns.chain_mode_4: the row entered this lane's class through the ungated turnaround pass at the section 28.2 gate (match_mode 4). Always False on a vector emitted without --ungated
columns.guard_held_by_exp_046: occupied rows the tail guard returned to the price base, so this lane decided their value and the value is the base. Empty on an unguarded candidate. A later serve reads it to tell a guard-held row from a vector that disagrees with its file (round 5 FALLBACK, finding 6)
columns.moved_by_v20: the rows the shipped candidate actually moves off the file it is composed against (--against); a held airport is NOT moved, so this is narrower than served_by_exp_046, and on a candidate composed on a previous head it also carries the rows REVERTED to the price base, which this lane does not occupy
columns.noac: the exp-033 hold; these rows move in neither lane
columns.obs_has_clock: the class the desk named; the complement to serve is ~obs_has_clock
columns.occupied_by_exp_046: the rows this lane actually writes its own head on: served_by_exp_046 AND not held at the base. THIS is the column a later serve in either lane must complement -- `moved` includes rows this lane gives up (a revert), and `served_by_exp_046` includes rows it holds, so neither leaves every row owned exactly once
columns.written_by_exp_046: occupied AND this lane actually wrote a value here in THESE bytes: occupied_by_exp_046 minus the rows the class gained AFTER the candidate was built. Read this to ask what is in the file; read occupied_by_exp_046 to ask who owns the row next

from: serve.ranking_block() -- the same block the served candidate was built from
gained_modes_what: the match modes whose rows this lane's class holds and these bytes do NOT carry a value for. Empty when the candidate serves every occupied row

totals.chain_mode_4_what: the ungated chain rows the section 28.2 gate keeps (step 0 at 62.405 s, |P - AOBT| <= 1,299 s, runway agreement). They are in THIS lane's class and in exp-047-queue's complement under the shipped matcher, which is the section 14 handshake this vector exists to settle
totals.class_gained_carrying_another_lanes_valu: of those, the rows whose bytes are NOT the price base, because exp-047-queue moves them today. The handover queue's rider 2 names: this lane owns the row next, the other lane's value is in the file until the next serve writes it
totals.class_gained_since_the_candidate_what: occupied rows this lane's class did not contain when the candidate was written: the turnaround pass's mode-3 rows. They are OCCUPIED -- this lane owns them next -- and NOT written_by_exp_046, because these bytes predate them. The next serve must write every one of them
totals.complement_that_leaves_every_row_once_is: ~occupied_by_exp_046 -- every row this lane does not write its own head on, including the held airport and any row reverted to the price base
totals.occupied_rows_at_the_price_base_why: the class moved under bytes already written: this vector is emitted on a newer matcher than the candidate was built with, so it carries rows the candidate could not have served

superseded_reading_do_not_use.why: it strands every row this lane REVERTED to the price base: those rows are changed and so are excluded from the complement, but no lane owns them (round 4 FALLBACK, finding 4)

what: this lane's class vector on the two ranking months, written once so the composition reads a file instead of re-deriving it
